correctness.rationale: Plancherel and orthogonality prove that the combined two-window STFT is an isometry. Explicit integrals yield the 2x2 fiber G. Matrix multiplication gives a scalar Gaussian skew commutator. Diagonalization and the essential-range theorem give the full purely absolutely continuous imaginary interval, its multiplicity and no point spectrum; differentiation proves the unique sharp threshold gap. 714 independent finite checks replay successfully. All boundary cases (equal thresholds, zero in spectrum, nonattainment, noncompactness) are covered by the proof.

The result provides the complete continuous spectral type and sharp parameter optimum for nested half-plane measurements, including no eigenvalues, no norm-attaining signals, and essential-norm equality; these are meaningful operator-theoretic features beyond a single matrix evaluation.
